fail_semantics.arc01_gap_avoided: ARC-01 omitted TIMING_CONTROL from its gate fail_semantics enumeration; ARC-03 states a general rule AND enumerates all four controls
fail_semantics.rule: MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED => FINAL_STATUS = DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal). No retuning of the primary based on control results is permitted.
fail_semantics.spec_consequence: MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED => ARC03 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal). No retuning of the primary based on control results is permitted.

gate_set_applied_to_controls: identical G1..G11 and identical estimator conventions

answers.alters_decision_time: NO - the signal bars and thresholds are unchanged
answers.alters_entry_time: YES - displaced by +12 bars (+60 minutes) from the primary entry
answers.alters_funding_window: YES - necessarily, because the entry/exit instants move; the SAME frozen cashflow rule is applied to the displaced window
answers.alters_holding_time: NO - still exactly 12 bars from the (displaced) entry
answers.alters_signal_eligibility: NO - the primary signal set is reused unchanged
answers.one_sided_by_causality: the symmetric -12-bar displacement is NOT admitted because it would place the entry before the decision instant (PIT violation)
answers.requires_post_result_discretion: NO - the displacement is a fixed +HOLDING_BARS

per_control.raw_definition: Take the PRIMARY signal set unchanged. Displace the entry by exactly +HOLDING_BARS = +12 bars (60 minutes) relative to the primary entry: entry_time_control = primary_entry_time_ms + 3600000; exit_time_control = entry_time_control + 3600000 (the same 12-bar hold). The rule, the signal bars and the thresholds are untouched; only the shock-to-holding-window alignment is destroyed.

Take the PRIMARY signal set unchanged (same signal bars, same entry times, same exit times). Set direction = with-the-push: an up-push signal becomes LONG instead of SHORT, a down-push signal becomes SHORT instead of LONG. Same costs, same funding accounting, same gates.

Re-generate the signal set with the participation-shock condition REMOVED: a signal requires ONLY EXCURSION_RECORD(t) AND EXHAUSTION(t) (range record against the same 30 same-slot references, plus strict majority retracement). The volume record is neither required nor consulted. Direction, entry, exit, holding, costs, funding accounting and the gate set are identical to the primary.

per_control.direction_mapping: per trade in frozen emission order: flipped = net * (+1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1)
per_control.eligibility_set: the primary realized net trade returns at 10 bps, unchanged in count and timestamps
per_control.raw_definition: Take the PRIMARY realized net trade returns at PRIMARY_COST_BPS in the frozen emission order. Using rng = random.Random(20260915), for each trade in order compute flipped_i = net_return_i * (+1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1). Evaluate the FULL critical gate set (including the bootstrap and permutation gates, which use their own frozen seeds) on the flipped series.
